title: PoJK protests loosen Pak’s hold on Kashmir
description: The ongoing and violent protests in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir have multiple reasons, but the most contentious and in-focus is the abolition of 12 legislative assembly seats that are reserved for refugees from Indian-administered Kashmir. Islamabad’s civil-military establishment is unlikely to give in to the protestors: these seats allow them to hand-pick winners and control government formation in Muzaffarabad, bypassing local resident voters entirely.
